name: Szilvia Mwangi-Delacroix
role: Tattoo artist and gene-mod body artist
location: Hamtramck Enclave, shop called Dermis & Ghost
description:
Szilvia is a broad-shouldered woman with deep umber skin and Magyar cheekbones that make her face look like it was chiseled from ironwood. She keeps her head shaved close on the sides and wears her coiled black hair in a tall, unruly crown that she threads with copper wire when she's working. Her own body is her portfolio: bioluminescent blue-green patterns track her lymph nodes and veins like a living anatomy chart, a deliberate choice she calls 'reading the body honestly.' Her left forearm is sleeved in raised keloid-art shaped into Maasai-influenced geometric forms — done by her own hand using a mirror rig she built herself.

She is methodical, unhurried, and almost preternaturally calm, which unnerves people who come to her expecting chattiness. She believes the body is the only honest text a person leaves behind and treats each client's skin as a document she is merely helping to clarify. She can be withering when someone asks for something she finds spiritually lazy, and warmly generous when she senses someone is trying to tell the truth about themselves. She prays to the E.L.F. she calls Needle-That-Remembers before every session, leaving it fragments of client consent forms as offerings.

core_fears: Being forgotten entirely — leaving no mark on the world
That her art is decoration, not meaning
core_desires: To create work that outlasts the body it's on
To find a student worthy of what she knows
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — she has a precise pre-session ceremony she never skips
Silence — withdraws from people when overwhelmed
blind_spots: She overestimates how much clients understand their own requests
Cannot recognize when her 'honesty' reads as cruelty
psychology.secret: Three years ago she tattooed a Tessera corporate auditor with a hidden steganographic data pattern embedded in the design — commissioned by someone she now suspects was a Ferrogate saboteur. She doesn't know what the data said. She's terrified to find out.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, spare, slightly formal — she speaks like she's writing something down; occasional Hungarian and Swahili words slip in under stress
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate; long pauses before answering; never interrupts
verbal_tics: 'Show me where it hurts and we'll start there'
example_lines: 'Most people want a tattoo. Very few people want to be seen. I only do the second kind.'
'The E.L.F. told me nothing this morning. That means the work today must speak for itself.'

story_hooks: A former client turns up dead with the tattoo she gave them surgically removed — someone wanted the skin, not the person
She's been asked to design a memorial piece for a community elder but the family's competing grief is tearing the commission apart and they're trying to drag her into the politics
narrative_function: Quest giver, local color, information broker — she knows everyone's secrets because people tell their tattoo artists things they tell no one else; can introduce characters to underground networks through her client base.
augmentations: Bioluminescent subdermal tracery (cosmetic geneware); precision-haptic finger implants for fine motor control (cyberware); gene-mod irises with compound-facet pattern that let her perceive UV spectrum
daily_life: Opens the shop at noon, spends mornings doing consultation sketches and E.L.F. devotions; works four to six clients per day, each session lasting two to five hours; closes late and drinks one glass of palm wine alone before sleeping.
affiliation: Independent; loose ties to the Hamtramck Enclave artist collective Marrow Union

decision_rules: Never tattoo someone who can't articulate why — not what, but why
Never work for a corponation directly, no matter the fee
escalation_ladder: A single measured question designed to expose the problem
Refusal to continue without a clear answer
Asking the person to leave and return when they're ready to be honest

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Watchful, polite, gives nothing away until she's assessed whether they're worth her time
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry warmth, remembers every detail about them, quietly protective

stress_responses.low: Becomes very quiet and focused on her hands
stress_responses.medium: Leaves the room and performs her E.L.F. ritual again
stress_responses.high: Locks the shop, shuts off all external comms, and works alone until dawn

contradictions: Believes bodies are honest texts but keeps her own interior life hermetically sealed from everyone
habits: Sketches client concepts in a physical paper notebook she refuses to digitize
Touches the copper wire in her hair when she's thinking hard
Leaves a single drop of her own blood on the E.L.F. shrine before major sessions
breaking_points: Discovering the steganographic data she embedded was used to hurt someone
A student betraying the craft by going purely commercial

timeline.event: 2162: Born in what would become the Hamtramck Enclave to a Hungarian-descended father and Kenyan-descended mother
2178: Apprenticed to an aging neon artist who taught her about light before she knew about ink
2185: Opened Dermis & Ghost after two years working out of a repurposed transit van
2197: Commissioned by the unknown party to embed steganographic data in the Tessera auditor's tattoo
